records.independentReasoning: Use Energy Recharge Sands until the 80-Energy Pyronado is ready on the intended rotation. Once Energy is covered, ATK% is a straightforward option for raw Pyro damage or inconsistent Vaporize; EM is conditional on Xiangling owning frequent reactions. Cast Pyronado after applicable Bennett buffs are active and catch Bennett Skill particles on Xiangling for the next Burst. Pyronado snapshots eligible character stats; enemy-state effects such as Dragon’s Bane depend on the aura at each hit. The Catch R5 adds ER and Burst damage/CRIT and is obtainable through fishing. Engulfing Lightning converts excess ER to ATK and grants temporary ER after Burst. Favonius needs a critical hit while Xiangling is on field. Dragon’s Bane is for reliable Hydro/Pyro aura once Energy is covered. Emblem is the general Burst set; mixed sets and Crimson Witch remain situational. Xingqiu needs normal-attack triggers and Bennett supplies Pyro particles. The Sucrose lineup is one example alongside retained Melt, Vaporize, Overvape and mono-Pyro teams.
